forcedChoices.choice: ustedes / los (plural) for Michael speaking to Adam and Eve together
forcedChoices.reason: The message speaks to the pair; the packet rule gives ustedes for the plural you.

forcedChoices.choice: Adam ben Adam kept in its English form
forcedChoices.reason: It is a patronymic name form, not the plain name Adam; changing it to Adán ben Adán would alter the name.
Spanish has one common word for both; the qualifier keeps the two English words apart.
Here ultimate has its ordinary sense of final, not the absonite sense.

forcedChoices.choice: aside set off with paired long dashes
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish closes a dashed aside with a second dash before the period.
